connector.name: Secapi
connector.registryDescription: SEC & financial-data MCP: filings, financials, ownership, factors, fund letters, prompts.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.secapi.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.secapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: secapi.ai API key (secapi_live_… / secapi_test_…). Create one at https://secapi.ai/dashboard. Sent on every MCP request.
